newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenyan coffee prices seen firmer.
newsitem.headline: Kenyan coffee prices seen firmer.

text.p: Kenyan coffee prices were seen firmer on short covering at the weekly coffee auction on Tuesday, auction officials said.
Grade Cs averaged $178 per 50-kg bag from $169 while grade ABs averaged $184.5 from 180. Grade AAs averaged $185.5 from 181.
"The market remains very firm but premium prices appear to have reached their top levels," a coffee board report said.
The coffee board said it sold all 22,020 60-kg bags of coffee it had offered for sale compared to 18,739 bags sold last week. -- Wambui Chege, Nairobi Newsroom ++254-2 330-261
